title: X18: Export performs 4 independent fetches against a live-mirroring store with no quiesce

description: Produces a torn bundle (orphan journal entries the importer then drops - permanently, via S9b's reseed path). Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1d export-schema-completeness. Sweep: cross-process. Fix: exporter takes one consistent snapshot in a single perform.
